mentions.name: Knowledge management system
mentions.description: A knowledge management system built in TypeScript with SolidJS, developed as an evening side project to scratch the author's own (and employer's) itch. The project is partly vibe-coded and partly a way to learn by breaking things, with the author enjoying SolidJS' JSX approach.
mentions.problem: A personal (and quietly employer-related) itch for a knowledge management tool to organize information.
mentions.source_excerpt: Scratching my own (and my employer's, but they don't know that) itch and building a knowledge management system as a nerdy way of spending evenings.

evidence.value: Scratching my own (and my employer's, but they don't know that) itch and building a knowledge management system as a nerdy way of spending evenings.
